as_told.title: Bradshaw Ranch transmedium UFOs and armed guards

plain: At Bradshaw Ranch near Sedona, Arizona, a place known for UFO sightings, unknown craft are said to fly in and out of a nearby peak called Secret Mountain, a story looked into by the investigative journalist Ross Coulthart. Michels brings it up in several episodes, drawing on Coulthart's work and a work called Sentinels of Ether; at one point he calls them craft that move between air and ground, "going in and out of the mountain," and compares the site to Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property famous for strange events, while elsewhere he adds that the US government took over the site, "a move that raised some eyebrows," and speaks of armed guards. If true, it would mean something is hidden inside the mountain.
